definition.name: Business Expenses
definition.comment: Incurred expenses, no payment status. SQL recalculates allocations from historical contributions; referral transaction identity is immutable. No historical backfill.

Ref Offset Payment.name: Ref Offset Payment
Ref Offset Payment.comment: R111: the Referral Rebate Offset payment that settled this referral rebate on the referrer's loan; null when the rebate is paid out. Set by Loan Close only.

Rebate Rate.name: Rebate Rate
Rebate Rate.comment: R120: referral rebate rate (percent) applied when this rebate was booked (REFERRAL_REBATE_V2); null on rows booked before V135 and on other expenses.

Rebate Cap.name: Rebate Cap
Rebate Cap.comment: R120: referral rebate cap (baht) applied when this rebate was booked (REFERRAL_REBATE_V2); null on rows booked before V135 and on other expenses.

Ref Rebate Settlement.name: Ref Rebate Settlement
Ref Rebate Settlement.comment: R129: the settlement that paid this pending referral rebate (REFERRAL_REBATE_V3); null while pending, on offset-only and legacy rows and on other expenses. Set and cleared by the settlement command only.

Business Expenses_Ref Offset Payment_fke.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("Ref Offset Payment") REFERENCES "Payments"("Row ID")

Business Expenses_check2.definition: CHECK ("Source Type" <> 'Referral Rebate'::text OR "Amount"::numeric > 0::numeric AND "Ref Related Loan" IS NOT NULL AND "Ref Related Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND "Ref Payee Borrower" IS NOT NULL AND "Source Key" = ('REFERRAL_REBATE:'::text || "Ref Related Loan") AND ("Rule Version" = 'REFERRAL_REBATE_V1'::text OR ("Rule Version" = ANY (ARRAY['REFERRAL_REBATE_V2'::text, 'REFERRAL_REBATE_V3'::text])) AND "Rebate Rate" IS NOT NULL AND "Rebate Cap" IS NOT NULL))

cash_ledger_direction.name: cash_ledger_direction
cash_ledger_direction.definition: CHECK (COALESCE("Ref From Cash Holder", "Ref To Cash Holder") IS NOT NULL AND ("Ref From Cash Holder" IS DISTINCT FROM "Ref To Cash Holder" OR "Ref From Cash Account" IS NOT NULL AND "Ref To Cash Account" IS NOT NULL AND "Ref From Cash Account" <> "Ref To Cash Account"))

cash_ledger_source.name: cash_ledger_source
cash_ledger_source.definition: CHECK ("Entry Origin" = 'Manual'::text AND "Source Type" = 'Manual'::text AND "Source Key" = ('MANUAL:'::text || "Row ID") AND "Ref Payment" IS NULL AND "Ref Loan" IS NULL AND "Ref Settlement" IS NULL AND "Ref Rebate Settlement" IS NULL AND ("Movement Type" = ANY (ARRAY['Cash Handover'::text, 'Expense Reimbursement'::text, 'Opening Balance'::text, 'Manual Correction'::text])) OR "Entry Origin" = 'System'::text AND ("Source Type" = 'Payment'::text AND "Movement Type" = 'Payment Receipt'::text AND "Source Key" = ('PAYMENT:'::text || "Ref Payment") AND "Ref Payment" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("Ref Payment", "Ref Loan", "Ref Business Expense", "Ref Settlement", "Ref Rebate Settlement") = 1 OR "Source Type" = 'Loan'::text AND "Movement Type" = 'Loan Disbursement'::text AND "Source Key" = ('LOAN:'::text || "Ref Loan") AND "Ref Loan" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("Ref Payment", "Ref Loan", "Ref Business Expense", "Ref Settlement", "Ref Rebate Settlement") = 1 OR "Source Type" = 'Business Expense'::text AND "Movement Type" = 'Business Expense'::text AND "Source Key" = ('EXPENSE:'::text || "Ref Business Expense") AND "Ref Business Expense" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("Ref Payment", "Ref Loan", "Ref Business Expense", "Ref Settlement", "Ref Rebate Settlement") = 1 OR "Source Type" = 'Settlement'::text AND "Movement Type" = 'Partner Settlement'::text AND "Source Key" = ('SETTLEMENT:'::text || "Ref Settlement") AND "Ref Settlement" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("Ref Payment", "Ref Loan", "Ref Business Expense", "Ref Settlement", "Ref Rebate Settlement") = 1 OR "Source Type" = 'Rebate Settlement'::text AND "Movement Type" = 'Rebate Settlement'::text AND "Source Key" = ('REBATESETTLEMENT:'::text || "Ref Rebate Settlement") AND "Ref Rebate Settlement" IS NOT NULL AND num_nonnulls("Ref Payment", "Ref Loan", "Ref Business Expense", "Ref Settlement", "Ref Rebate Settlement") = 1))

definition.name: pwa_notify_content_v5
definition.result: TABLE(found boolean, event_type text, language text, borrower_name text, amount numeric, rebate_amount numeric, rebate_payee text, rebate_payable numeric, payment_method text, rebate_loan text, late_charge_amount numeric, rebates jsonb)
definition.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pwa_notify_content_v5(delivery uuid, generation bigint)
 RETURNS TABLE(found boolean, event_type text, language text, borrower_name text, amount numeric, rebate_amount numeric, rebate_payee text, rebate_payable numeric, payment_method text, rebate_loan text, late_charge_amount numeric, rebates jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 PERFORM public.pwa_worker_guard_v1('dispatch');
 RETURN QUERY SELECT src.source_found,
  -- A chat reply carries its outcome ('chat.reply:ok' / 'chat.reply:failed', from source_version 'ok:<message>').
  CASE WHEN e.event_type='chat.reply' THEN 'chat.reply:'||split_part(e.source_version,':',1) ELSE e.event_type END,
  CASE WHEN recipient."Language Preference"='ไทย' THEN 'th' ELSE 'en' END::text,
  -- Chat: the thread title. Thai: the Thai name. English: the English name only ("Description"); none when blank.
  CASE WHEN e.source_kind='chat' THEN src.source_title WHEN recipient."Language Preference"='ไทย' THEN b."Borrower Name" ELSE nullif(btrim(b."Description",E' \t\r\n\f\v'),'') END,
  src.source_amount,
  rb.rebate_amount,
  CASE WHEN rb.rebate_amount IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN recipient."Language Preference"='ไทย' THEN pb."Borrower Name" ELSE coalesce(nullif(btrim(pb."Description",E' \t\r\n\f\v'),''),pb."Borrower Name") END,
  rb.rebate_payable,
  src.payment_method,
  (SELECT x."Ref Related Loan" FROM public."Business Expenses" x WHERE e.source_kind='payment' AND x."Ref Offset Payment"=e.source_id ORDER BY x."Row ID" COLLATE "C" LIMIT 1),
  CASE WHEN e.source_kind='payment' THEN (SELECT coalesce(sum(y."Late Charge Paid"::numeric),0) FROM public."Repayments" y WHERE y."Ref Payment"=e.source_id) END,
  -- R129: every rebate (R119 order) with its state, pending amount and the payee's owed total; [] when none; NULL on chat.
  CASE WHEN e.source_kind='chat' THEN NULL ELSE (
   SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('amount',x."Amount"::numeric,
     'payee',CASE WHEN recipient."Language Preference"='ไทย' THEN xb."Borrower Name" ELSE coalesce(nullif(btrim(xb."Description",E' \t\r\n\f\v'),''),xb."Borrower Name") END,
     'payable',x."Amount"::numeric-coalesce(o."Amount Received"::numeric,0),
     'state',CASE WHEN x."Rule Version"='REFERRAL_REBATE_V3' AND x."Ref Rebate Settlement" IS NOT NULL THEN 'paid' WHEN coalesce(o."Amount Received"::numeric,0)>0 THEN 'offset'
      WHEN x."Rule Version"='REFERRAL_REBATE_V3' THEN 'pending' ELSE 'paid-at-close' END,
     'ruleVersion',x."Rule Version",
     'pending',public.pwa_rebate_pending_v1(x."Row ID"),
     'owed',public.pwa_rebates_owed_v1(x."Ref Payee Borrower")) ORDER BY x."Row ID" COLLATE "C"),'[]'::jsonb)
   FROM public."Business Expenses" x LEFT JOIN public."Payments" o ON o."Row ID"=x."Ref Offset Payment" LEFT JOIN public."Borrowers" xb ON xb."Row ID"=x."Ref Payee Borrower"
   WHERE x."Source Type"='Referral Rebate' AND ((e.event_type='loan.closed' AND e.source_kind='loan' AND x."Ref Related Loan"=e.source_id)
    OR (e.event_type='payment.posted' AND e.source_kind='payment' AND x."Ref Related Loan" IN (SELECT y."Row ID" FROM public."Loans" y WHERE y."Ref Closing Payment"=e.source_id)))) END
 FROM public.pwa_notification_deliveries d JOIN public.pwa_notification_events e ON e.event_id=d.event_id
 LEFT JOIN public."Partners" recipient ON recipient."Row ID"=d.recipient_partner_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT true AS source_found,p."Ref Borrower" AS borrower_id,p."Amount Received"::numeric AS source_amount,NULL::text AS source_title,p."Payment Method" AS payment_method FROM public."Payments" p WHERE e.source_kind='payment' AND p."Row ID"=e.source_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT true,l."Ref Borrowers",l."Principal Amount"::numeric,NULL::text,NULL::text FROM public."Loans" l WHERE e.source_kind='loan' AND l."Row ID"=e.source_id
  UNION ALL
  SELECT true,NULL::text,NULL::numeric,t.title,NULL::text FROM public.pwa_chat_threads t WHERE e.source_kind='chat' AND t.id::text=e.source_id AND t.partner_id=d.recipient_partner_id
 ) source_row ON true
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT coalesce(source_row.source_found,false) AS source_found,source_row.borrower_id,source_row.source_amount,source_row.source_title,source_row.payment_method) src
 LEFT JOIN public."Borrowers" b ON b."Row ID"=src.borrower_id
 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT x."Amount"::numeric AS rebate_amount,x."Ref Payee Borrower" AS payee_id,x."Amount"::numeric-coalesce(o."Amount Received"::numeric,0) AS rebate_payable
  FROM public."Business Expenses" x LEFT JOIN public."Payments" o ON o."Row ID"=x."Ref Offset Payment"
  WHERE x."Source Type"='Referral Rebate' AND ((e.event_type='loan.closed' AND e.source_kind='loan' AND x."Ref Related Loan"=e.source_id)
   OR (e.event_type='payment.posted' AND e.source_kind='payment' AND x."Ref Related Loan" IN (SELECT y."Row ID" FROM public."Loans" y WHERE y."Ref Closing Payment"=e.source_id)))
  ORDER BY x."Row ID" COLLATE "C" LIMIT 1
 ) rb ON true
 LEFT JOIN public."Borrowers" pb ON pb."Row ID"=rb.payee_id
 WHERE d.delivery_id=$1 AND d.lease_generation=$2 AND d.state='leased' AND d.lease_expires_at>clock_timestamp();
END $function$
definition.comment: mw-access:governance fixed notification boundary; explicit capability only

definition.name: pwa_rebate_pending_v1
definition.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pwa_rebate_pending_v1(p_expense text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN x."Rule Version"='REFERRAL_REBATE_V3' AND x."Ref Rebate Settlement" IS NULL
   THEN greatest(x."Amount"::numeric-coalesce(o."Amount Received"::numeric,0),0) ELSE 0 END
 FROM public."Business Expenses" x LEFT JOIN public."Payments" o ON o."Row ID"=x."Ref Offset Payment"
 WHERE x."Row ID"=p_expense AND x."Source Type"='Referral Rebate';
$function$
definition.comment: R129: the pending (unpaid) amount of a referral rebate expense: REFERRAL_REBATE_V3, not linked to a settlement, Amount less its offset payment; 0 for offset-only, paid and legacy rows; null for an unknown or non-referral expense. Read only.

definition.name: pwa_rebate_settlement_version_v1
definition.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pwa_rebate_settlement_version_v1(p_id text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT encode(sha256(convert_to(((to_jsonb(s)-'created_at')||jsonb_build_object('created_at',to_char(s.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"')))::text,'UTF8')),'hex')
 FROM public.pwa_rebate_settlements s WHERE s.id=p_id;
$function$
definition.comment: R129: version of a rebate settlement for rebate-settlement.delete (sha256 of the row as JSON, created_at in UTC); null for an unknown id. services/business/referrers.mjs uses the identical SQL text.

definition.name: pwa_rebates_owed_v1
definition.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.pwa_rebates_owed_v1(p_referrer text)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(sum(greatest(x."Amount"::numeric-coalesce(o."Amount Received"::numeric,0),0)),0)
 FROM public."Business Expenses" x LEFT JOIN public."Payments" o ON o."Row ID"=x."Ref Offset Payment"
 WHERE x."Ref Payee Borrower"=p_referrer AND x."Source Type"='Referral Rebate' AND x."Rule Version"='REFERRAL_REBATE_V3' AND x."Ref Rebate Settlement" IS NULL;
$function$
definition.comment: R129: what a referrer is owed: the sum of pwa_rebate_pending_v1 over the referrer's referral rebate expenses. Read only.

definition.name: pwa_referral_rebate_projection_v1
definition.comment: R111/R118/R120/R129: the referral rebate a Loan Close with this calculation creates (create_referral_rebate rule: the referrer's rate of interest and late charges, at most the referrer's cap), its referrer, whether the referrer has an open loan, the profit base, the terms (rate, cap, custom) and owedBefore (the referrer's pending rebates now); null when none. Read only.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rebate_settlement_cash_source()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN PERFORM public.sync_cash_ledger('Rebate Settlement',NEW.id); RETURN NULL; END $function$
definition.comment: R129: projects a rebate settlement into "Cash Ledger" (sync_cash_ledger, the ledger owner's definer).

definition.name: rebate_settlement_row_guard
definition.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rebate_settlement_row_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Rebate settlements are immutable; delete the settlement and record it again'; END IF;
 -- The projection goes with its source (the business_source_delete pattern; the ledger guard allows it at depth 2).
 DELETE FROM public."Cash Ledger" WHERE "Entry Origin"='System' AND "Source Type"='Rebate Settlement' AND "Source Key"='REBATESETTLEMENT:'||OLD.id;
 RETURN OLD;
END $function$
definition.comment: R129: a rebate settlement never changes after insert; its delete removes its cash projection first.

definition.name: sync_cash_ledger
